answer: System-liveness note (v1). Where an inlet lets water find the lowest cost path, a sybil fleet seeks the lowest-cost identity path; PoA raises that floor by charging per-identity work rather than per-stake, so cloning multiplies cost like stacking basalt rather than diluting it. A lone honest knoll of real effort therefore outranks a mountain of cheap duplicates, because the economy prices distinct labor, not headcount.
